$comment: Every file `npm pack` publishes, pinned. Generated by scripts/package-files.ts from `npm pack --dry-run --json` — never hand-edited; checked inside the check:package gate step (a file added, removed or made executable, or a legal text changed, fails) and by the package-files-parity rule of verify-docs (package.json files, declared.bundle budgets, the legal texts on disk). role is derived from the path; sha256 is pinned for the legal texts only — the build output is held by the byte budgets, the documents by verify-docs, and package.json changes with every version and devDependency bump.
